changelog: v4.4.0: Set SEO metadata generator to default OFF (inactive) for all existing campaigns, preventing unintended changes while allowing on-demand activation per campaign. Full multi-SEO plugin integration (Rank Math, Yoast, AIOSEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework) with strict Google SERP character boundary compliance (Meta Title 50-60 chars, Meta Description 120-155 chars).
